accepted.cause: Revenue decrease driven by COVID-19 disruption
accepted.effect: Revenue miss lowers Q2 top-line expectations
accepted.evidence_span: Lower second quarter revenue was driven by lower procedures volume and system placements, primarily as a result of the significant disruption caused by the COVID-19 pandemic

accepted.cause: 20% decline in instruments and accessories revenue
accepted.effect: Procedure volume drop reduces recurring revenue outlook
accepted.evidence_span: Second quarter 2020 instruments and accessories revenue decreased by 20% to $461 million, compared with $579 million in the second quarter of 2019, primarily driven by an approximately 19% decline in da Vinci procedure volume

accepted.effect: Capital equipment sales miss lowers FY installation guidance
accepted.evidence_span: Second quarter 2020 systems revenue decreased by 24% to $261 million, compared with $344 million in the second quarter of 2019
